investigations.summary: PMM-T2036 failed again in all 11 nightly lanes (docker, docker arm64, ami, helm, ha, compat 3.7.1-3.9.1, gssapi), in every case only with 'Metrics without data are: Failing Backup Agents' (Nightly 2/4 shard; one PMM-T305 loading-bar flake on ha passed on retry). Same cause as night 103: the Failing Backup Agents table added by percona/pmm#6109 is empty when no PBM agent fails, and MongodbBackupDetails.noDataMetrics on main still lacks it. The one-line fix is in pmm-qa#1740, which is not merged yet; merging it clears these lanes. Deduped from the run logs, not re-reproduced.
